name: docs-editor-drafts
title: Add shared Markdown drafts and automatic preview builds
description: Implement Phase 3 of the documentation workflow: hash-checked atomic Markdown saving, serialized preview builds, conflict handling, status reporting, and preview refresh.
creator: wg
notes: Phase 3 is deployed to kbdev. Local focused tests, editor build, VitePress build, and browser acceptance passed.
